episodes.163728: A brief waterspout was observed southwest of Key West in association with a convective rain shower.  A broad upper trough extended from eastern Canada southward to the northwest Caribbean Sea.

events.county: Hawk Channel From West End Of Seven Mile Bridge To Halfmoon Shoal Out To The Reef
events.narrative: A waterspout was observed offshore Fort Zachary Taylor State Park of Key West.  The condensation funnel cloud extended only one-tenth of the way down from cloud base.
